title: Story premise ENT071: The Empty Seat Sketch
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (silent emotional stories). Hook: The seat stays. Takeaway/theme: A picture can hold an absence without hiding it.
description: A sketch artist wants to draw a two-person picnic, but the second seat stays empty and every attempt to erase it leaves a mark. They turn the mark into a flower growing beside the seat and finish a drawing that has room for both absence and today’s sunshine.
